data.one_liner: Strongly typed, event-based HTTP client wrapping Dio.
data.what_it_does: SturdyHttp is an opinionated HTTP client wrapping Dio that provides object-based network requests, event-based request notifications, and worker isolate deserialization.
use_when: You want an opinionated, structured wrapper around Dio for network calls.
You need worker isolate deserialization to avoid blocking the main thread.
You want event-based notifications during request execution.
avoid_when: you prefer raw Dio or standard HTTP clients without opinions.
You do not want to manage request objects and response wrappers.
weaknesses: Opinionated structure may not fit all application architectures
Requires learning custom request and response types

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a powerful, flexible HTTP client without the opinionated abstractions and wrappers of SturdyHttp.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a simpler, lightweight HTTP client built into the standard Dart libraries.
